      • setChallengeMessage

        public void setChallengeMessage​(TagData challengeMessage)
                         throws OctaneSdkException
        The user-provided 48-bit clear text message to be sent to the tag to encrypt

        For ImpinjTagAuthenticate, the clear text message is 42 bits, preceded by a fixed header whose 6th bit indicates if the tag should add the "short" TID in its reply.

        Here we accept a 48-bit TagData, but not that we will overwrite bits 1 through 6 when generating the header.

        Overrides:
        setChallengeMessage in class AbstractTagAuthenticateOp
        Throws:
        OctaneSdkException
